finalText:
Found it. The bundler bump changed the shape of the options it hands your code, and two spots never caught up.

`src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount` — that was crashing the link step outright. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false` for the backoff flag, but the new config loader leaves it `undefined` when unset, so that threw too.

I updated both to match the new shapes. Build now finishes clean: 0 errors, exit code 0. The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, nothing broken.
